sample_light_position: sample a random light position with norm >= 1.0 in the range [1.5, -0.2, 0.8] to [3, 0.2, 1.5]
perturb_orientation: perturb a 3D or 4D orientation vector by up to a given angle in degrees using a JAX random key
domain_randomize: domain randomize an mjx model with randomized geom colors, camera poses, and lighting for num_worlds parallel environments
create_randomized_vision: create randomized vision parameters for a Franka Panda simulation including colors, cameras, and lights
run_domain_randomization: run domain randomization on a Mujoco mjx model to generate varied visual appearances across parallel worlds
